change_summary: CFB RUN IT vs PAPER parity audit and tests; runner fixes: enforce frozen model sha pin, compare kickoff_ct on the game's CT date. Model, paper pipeline and weights unchanged.
assumptions: Model weights are untested; this PR does not change them.
SP+ is centred on captured file means as model input; input mapping, not a weight change.
One-sided DK milestone props use implied probability including vig as market p.
Player usage is derived from CFBD season totals; not validated predictively.

baseline.metric: Prospective untouched CFB forecast accuracy versus same-time market
